reason: The Send date field has autocomplete="garbage", which is not a valid token, but it holds the date the invoice goes out, not information about the user, so 1.3.5 does not apply to it. It exposes role textbox and the name Send date.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve one of the purposes in its Input Purposes list (the only date purpose is bday, the user's own birth date). The invoice send date is not on that list, so no token is required and an invalid one breaks nothing. 4.1.1 Parsing is gone from WCAG 2.2. No other A or AA criterion covers an invalid autocomplete token.
